name: Neurotype Cafe
source:
In Neurotype Cafe, players take the role of Nia as she handles her first few days as a new barista at The Junction Cafe! Develop relationships with characters, create drinks, and manage your social energy in a story about self-acceptance, expectations, and perfectionism told from the perspective of a neurodivergent character!

[from [url=https://lenadias.itch.io/neurotype-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在Neurotype Cafe中，玩家扮演Nia的角色，处理她在The Junction Cafe担任新咖啡师的头几天！在一个从神经分歧角色的角度讲述的关于自我接受、期望和完美主义的故事中，与角色建立关系、制作饮料并管理你的社交能量！

[来自[url=https://lenadias.itch.io/neurotype-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
